title: Info toasts vanish after 5 s with no pause, taking the new Jira issue link along
body:
## Summary
Only undo toasts pause on hover/focus; info toasts dismiss on a fixed 5 s timer. The Accept notice carries the only link to the just-created Jira issue, and it disappears while a keyboard user is still tabbing to it (WCAG 2.2.1 Timing adjustable).

## Description
Toast.jsx:7-11 starts a NOTICE_MS timer for every 'info' toast (useCommitWindow.js:10 NOTICE_MS = 5000); pause/resume are wired only when `undoable` (Toast.jsx:17-18). The toast region sits at the end of <main> (routes/inbox/index.jsx:171 renders ToastRegion last), so reaching it by Tab from the list takes many stops. The accept notice embeds the issue link (routes/inbox/InboxDialogs.jsx:25); after the dialog closes focus goes to the next row, and the card leaves the list, so the toast is the one place the link to the new issue appears on the page.

## Flow
- Accept DW-7 with Ctrl+Enter: toast 'DW-7 accepted as SHOP-123' with a link
- Keyboard user starts tabbing toward the toast region
- At 5 s the toast and its link are removed, even if the link has focus

## Expected impact
The new issue's link stays reachable; timed content meets WCAG 2.2.1.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a notice holding a link never times out under focus or hover
Before: info toast removed at 5 s regardless of hover/focus
After: info toasts pause on hover/focus like undo toasts (or a toast with interactive content does not auto-dismiss)
Method: simulation - walked mouse-hover, keyboard-focus and idle cases through Toast.jsx timers; no browser in a read-only scout
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: forge/static/app/src/components/Toast.jsx:8 `if (toast.kind !== 'info') return undefined;` :9 `const t = setTimeout(() => onDismiss(toast.id), noticeMs);` :17 `onMouseEnter={undoable ? () => onPause(toast.id) : undefined} ...` :18 `onFocus={undoable ? () => onPause(toast.id) : undefined} ...` ; useCommitWindow.js:10 `const NOTICE_MS = 5000;` ; routes/inbox/InboxDialogs.jsx:25 `cw.notify(<>{c.ref} accepted{c.issue_ref && <> as {safeHref(c.issue_url) ? <a href=...`
impact_why: Every Accept; the toast holds the only on-page link to the issue just created

title: Delete the unused ProposalCard, LazyHistory, EvidenceList and deepLinkRef
body:
## Summary
About 100 lines of components/ProposalCard.jsx (the pre-redesign card) and deeplink.js deepLinkRef have zero consumers; the inbox, panel and CardDialog all render routes/inbox/Detail.jsx. The dead card still carries its own copy of the evidence-link and issue-link rendering, so a safeHref or gating change has two places to land.

## Description
Outside its own file, ProposalCard.jsx is imported only for LensBadge (routes/byline/index.jsx:8) and TriageHistory (routes/inbox/Detail.jsx:11). `ProposalCard` (components/ProposalCard.jsx:136), `LazyHistory` (:113, with LazyHistoryBody :122 and its own proposal.get call :123) and `EvidenceList` (:70, used only by the dead ProposalCard :173) have no importer anywhere in the repo. `deepLinkRef` (components/deeplink.js:57) has none either. docs/concepts/project-status-and-next-steps.md:141 still names ProposalCard.jsx as a place where gating lives.

## Flow
- Developer changes the evidence link rule in Detail.jsx
- grep finds the same rule in ProposalCard.jsx:74 and edits it too, or forgets
- Nothing renders the second copy; reviews and docs keep pointing at it

## Expected impact
One card renderer; smaller bundle; docs stop naming a dead file.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - zero dead exports in components/
Before: 4 exported symbols with 0 consumers (~100 lines)
After: 0; ProposalCard.jsx keeps LensBadge and TriageHistory (or they move)
Method: probe - repo-wide grep for each symbol name (excluding the defining file and dist)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: grep -rn 'ProposalCard\|deepLinkRef\|LazyHistory\|EvidenceList' (excluding ProposalCard.jsx, node_modules, dist) -> only routes/byline/index.jsx:8 `import { LensBadge } from '../../components/ProposalCard.jsx';`, routes/inbox/Detail.jsx:11 `import { TriageHistory } from '../../components/ProposalCard.jsx';`, deeplink.js:57 (its own definition), and docs/notes; components/ProposalCard.jsx:136 `export function ProposalCard(`, :113 `export function LazyHistory(`, :70 `export function EvidenceList(`
impact_why: Removes a second copy of link and gating rules that silently diverges

title: Test labels.js reason, status and evidence lists against shared/model.mjs
body:
## Summary
The Custom UI hand-copies the closed vocabularies (reject reasons, inbox statuses, evidence types) from forge/src/shared/model.mjs into components/labels.js, and the reject dialog's 1-6 shortcut range is a literal; no test ties any of them to the server list.

## Description
labels.js:17-24 REASONS (six codes), :12 STATUSES, :27-29 EVIDENCE_LABELS mirror forge/src/shared/model.mjs:23 REASONS and :24 EVIDENCE_TYPES and core/types.mjs:9 INBOX_STATUSES; labels.js says so in a comment only (:1-2, :16). useInboxKeys.js:61 hardcodes `/^[1-6]$/` and InboxDialogs.jsx:53 says '1 to 6'. Tests import labels.js only for deltaLine (forge/test/delta.test.mjs:15); grep of forge/test for REASONS/STATUSES/EVIDENCE finds nothing. A seventh reason on the server would show as a raw code in Reflect (REASON_LABELS fallback) and be unreachable by key. (The lens list's own registry is the already-known deferred 'open lens registry' item; this is the test for the other lists.)

## Flow
- Server adds reason 'duplicate' to shared/model.mjs
- Reflect shows 'duplicate' unlabelled; Reject dialog cannot offer it; key 7 does nothing
- No test fails

## Expected impact
A vocabulary change fails CI in one place instead of shipping a half-labelled UI.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - UI lists derived from or tested against ground truth
Before: 0 parity assertions for REASONS/STATUSES/EVIDENCE; key range literal
After: one node test asserting deepEqual of codes, and the key regex built from REASONS.length
Method: probe - grep of forge/test and labels.js consumers; the test itself would be written in the build
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: forge/static/app/src/components/labels.js:17 `export const REASONS = [` (6 entries :18-23) :12 `export const STATUSES = ['open', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'snoozed', 'merged'];` :27 `export const EVIDENCE_LABELS = {` ; forge/src/shared/model.mjs:23 `export const REASONS = ... (['false-positive', 'already-known', 'not-our-direction', 'not-worth-it', 'wrong-size', 'other']);` :24 `export const EVIDENCE_TYPES = ...` ; useInboxKeys.js:61 `if (kind === 'reject' && /^[1-6]$/.test(e.key) ...` ; grep -rn 'REASONS\|LENSES\|STATUSES' forge/test/*.mjs -> no output
impact_why: Closed vocabularies are the client-server contract the UI renders everywhere

predicted_why: precedent: 'missing byline.draftFix in forge/src/index.js:90 KEYS' was filed (known) - the guard is its root-cause follow-up
title: Test that every UI call() key is registered and allowed for its module
body:
## Summary
Nothing checks the Custom UI's call() keys against the Forge resolver registration (index.js KEYS) and MODULE_KEYS; the two dev bridges and the local server do not apply module gating at all, so a key that works in every dev mode can still answer an error in Forge.

## Description
The UI calls 21 keys (grep of call('...') in forge/static/app/src). Registration is a hand list (forge/src/index.js:90-92) and the gate is MODULE_KEYS (forge/src/core/app.mjs:304-309, resolverAllowed :312). The fixture bridge dispatches any handler by key (src/dev/bridge.js:306-311), http-bridge sends `module` only for the panel (src/dev/http-bridge.js:18), and tools/local-forge.mjs:236-237 calls forge.resolver without resolverAllowed. access.test.mjs:144-147 asserts four hand-picked pairs. The already-known missing byline.draftFix in KEYS is one instance of this gap; this proposal is the guard, not that fix: a test that scans static/app/src for call('<key>') per route, maps the route to its module (router.jsx MODULES/PAGES) and asserts KEYS.includes(key) && resolverAllowed(module, key).

## Flow
- Add a resolver key in core/app.mjs and a call() in a new route
- Fixture and dev:local both work
- Forge answers 'is not available from this Dowser view' or no function; only a deploy finds it

## Expected impact
The registration and gating door is checked from ground truth (the UI source) on every npm test.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - UI keys verified against registration
Before: 0 tests derive from the UI's call sites; 3 dev paths skip gating
After: 1 test over all call sites; a missing key fails CI
Method: probe - grep of call sites, KEYS and tests; the scan would be written in the build
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: forge/src/index.js:90 `const KEYS = ['inbox.list', 'proposal.get', ...` ; forge/src/core/app.mjs:312 `export const resolverAllowed = (moduleKey, key) => ...` ; forge/static/app/src/dev/bridge.js:309 `const h = handlers[key];` (no module check) ; src/dev/http-bridge.js:18 `...(surface() === 'panel' ? { module: 'dowser-evidence' } : {})` ; tools/local-forge.mjs:237 `return json(200, await forge.resolver(b.key, b.payload ?? {}, via));` ; forge/test/access.test.mjs:144-147 four literal resolverAllowed pairs
impact_why: The class of bug already found once (draftFix) reaches production silently

title: dev:local bridge drops the map's project/lens/area deep link and has no banner
body:
## Summary
The two @forge/bridge stand-ins disagree: the fixture bridge carries every inbox deep-link key (ref, project, lens, area) through getContext and router.navigate, the local-server bridge carries only ref, and has no banner surface or view.close.

## Description
bridge.js:320 LINK_KEYS = ['ref','project','lens','area'], used in getContext (:347) and router.navigate (:358). http-bridge.js builds the location with `?ref=` only (:42) and navigate keeps only `ref` (:52-53). A map heat-cell click (routes/map/index.jsx:66-67 -> deeplink.js inboxUrl sets project/lens/area) therefore opens an unfiltered inbox under `npm run dev:local`, the mode that runs against the real store. http-bridge's view has no `close` (vs bridge.js:349) and no 'banner' surface, so the doc-drift Banner (routes/byline/Banner.jsx) cannot be exercised against the local server at all.

## Flow
- npm run dev:local, open #map
- Click a heat cell with 3 open proposals
- Inbox shows every open proposal, not the 3 - looks like an area-filter bug that is not one

## Expected impact
dev:local reproduces Forge's deep links; no false bug reports from the dev path.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - both dev bridges honour the same link contract
Before: http-bridge carries 1 of 4 link keys; no banner/close
After: one shared linkQuery helper used by both bridges; banner surface and view.close in http-bridge
Method: simulation - walked a heat-cell URL through both navigate implementations; dev:local needs the local server running
Result: better
Gate: none
impact_why: Dev-path only, but it is the path that runs against the real store
